Photographed 25/03/2006.



This is the front block facing onto the road, and in view of the contribution below, maybe not the most important aspect of the listing.



The most recent Street View imagery available online dates from September 2009, and shows that the large coniferous tree on the right was felled by then. The first floor windows had been replaced by then, while the louvred shutters noted in the listing and visible in this photograph were not present anymore.
